beats.summary: Michael and Dwight struggle to get a large Christmas tree inside, breaking a ceiling tile in the process.

evidence.snippet: they push the tree up and it breaks through a ceiling tile.

beats.summary: Michael decides to sell the hacked off part of the tree as a mini-tree for charity.

evidence.snippet: Well, that is a perfectly good mini-tree, Kevin. And we are going to sell that to charity.
That's what Christmas is all about.

beats.summary: Jim prepares a Secret Santa gift for Pam filled with inside jokes and personal touches.

evidence.snippet: I got Pam in Secret Santa. And I got her this teapot, which I know she really wants

beats.summary: Michael insists on doubling the party supplies despite Angela's planning committee memo about disaster preparedness.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Double it. Double everything. Double ice cream. Double napkins. Double it. On me.
